versions.changelog:
Initial release introducing a comprehensive anatomy skill set based on the 10th edition of Systematic Anatomy.

- Covers 112 core systematic anatomy skills categorized by organ system and clinical relevance
- Skill groups include skeletal system, nervous system, head and neck, trunk and limbs, viscera, sensory pathways, integrative Chinese medicine anatomy, and terminology
- Organized for educational and clinical application referencing the latest national textbook
- Includes concise summaries and direct links to each skill module
